unit_definition: One passage per prose paragraph (a block of continuous prose between verses), per verse, and per lead-in set on a line of its own. A lead-in at the end of a prose line (उक्तं च ।, यतः ।) belongs to the prose. Joining a lead-in to its verse or prose, or splitting a paragraph into consecutive regions, is a grouping difference, not an ownership error.
